How does sudo work in Universe OS?

/usr/bin/sudo is a symlink to universe-privilege. Every root request opens a GUI dialog: app name, category, the command in monospace, red warning for dangerous ones. Grant durations: just-once / session / 5m / 30m / 1h. 45s auto-deny. No display = deny.

What is gate-exec?

The ONLY custom setuid-root binary (C). Approved commands are deposited as single-use tokens into /var/lib/universe/approved (0700) and gate-exec executes them with an env allowlist, deleting the token first.

Universe OS: How does sudo work in Universe OS?

/usr/bin/sudo is a symlink to universe-privilege. Every root request opens a GUI dialog: app name, category, the command in monospace, red warning for dangerous ones. Grant durations: just-once / session / 5m / 30m / 1h. 45s auto-deny. No display = deny.

Universe OS: What is gate-exec?

The ONLY custom setuid-root binary (C). Approved commands are deposited as single-use tokens into /var/lib/universe/approved (0700) and gate-exec executes them with an env allowlist, deleting the token first.
